badges.label: Downloads a program and runs it
badges.detail: From yilewang/llm-for-zotero on GitHub; not checked against a fingerprint written into the plugin

badges.label: Runs commands its AI assistant writes, with full access to your computer

badges.label: Signs in using another app's identity

badges.detail: Tables: llm_for_zotero_agent_coverage, llm_for_zotero_agent_run_events, llm_for_zotero_attachment_refs, llm_for_zotero_conversation_fork_links, llm_for_zotero_conversation_registry and 3 more
